svg.title: A 30-Day Smartlead Campaign, Sent to Calls
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-claude-code-smartlead-30-day-funnel; chapter number: 6; title: A 30-Day Smartlead Campaign, Sent to Calls; subtitle: Day-27 results of a Claude Code driven campaign with hand-written copy; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Emails Sent; value: 15000; display: ~15,000; conversion: 100%; detail: Smartlead campaign on an account running about a year.; label: Net-New Leads Reached; value: 8000; display: ~8,000; conversion: ~53% of sends; detail: Fresh contacts rather than repeat touches on the same list.; label: Replies; value: 500; display: ~500; conversion: ~6.3% of leads; detail: Copy written manually, not by AI, per the operator.; label: Interested Replies; value: 250; display: ~250; conversion: 50% of replies; detail: Half of all replies flagged as interested.; label: Calls; value: 57; display: 57; conversion: ~22.8% of interested; detail: Below the 35% interested-to-booked floor Matt Harriman uses as an inbox-management audit line.; caption: Roughly 15,000 sends produced 57 calls in under a month, with the operator crediting hand-written copy over AI-generated copy.; assumptions note: Stage counts are the operator's approximate figures. Conversion percentages are stage-to-stage arithmetic on those figures.; note: Source - Smartlead (NWEL3WNYDhg @ 00:09:43). Booking floor from Matt Harriman (hm5isqC1d74 @ 00:06:18).

circle.title: label: Emails Sent; value: 15000; display: ~15,000; conversion: 100%; detail: Smartlead campaign on an account running about a year.
label: Net-New Leads Reached; value: 8000; display: ~8,000; conversion: ~53% of sends; detail: Fresh contacts rather than repeat touches on the same list.
label: Replies; value: 500; display: ~500; conversion: ~6.3% of leads; detail: Copy written manually, not by AI, per the operator.
label: Interested Replies; value: 250; display: ~250; conversion: 50% of replies; detail: Half of all replies flagged as interested.
label: Calls; value: 57; display: 57; conversion: ~22.8% of interested; detail: Below the 35% interested-to-booked floor Matt Harriman uses as an inbox-management audit line.
